brief.role: Operations lead at a 35-person support team
brief.job: Determine whether Relay Notes Team is the appropriate plan and understand the cost and commitment.
brief.consequence: Choosing the wrong plan either leaves needed members unserved or commits the team to avoidable spend.
facts: Starter is $0 for up to 3 members and includes one workspace, the handoff template, and CSV export.
Team is $12 per member per month, billed monthly, and includes up to 100 members, unlimited workspaces, Slack links, and admin roles.
Enterprise is custom-priced and includes SAML SSO, SCIM, audit export, and a named implementation contact.
Annual billing is available only for Team at $120 per member per year. That equals two months less than twelve monthly payments. No other discount is offered.
All paid plans include a 14-day trial with no credit card. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period.
A 35-member team on Team costs $420 per month or $4,200 per year. The user may change seats during the billing period; no proration policy is supplied.
The appropriate next action for an undecided visitor is to start a trial or contact sales for Enterprise, not to imply that one plan is universally best.

House style, supplied by the client's brand system and binding like any other fact: light warm neutral ground; 1 accent hue drawn from: blue, lime, indigo; interface type is a grotesque sans set in sentence case; display and interface type share one family; corners rounded; borders hairline; shadows none; overall density moderate; standard chrome includes: top navigation bar, wordmark logo, auth links, primary CTA button in nav, page heading, monthly/yearly toggle, tier cards in a row, highlighted tier with badge, price figure with unit caption, per-card CTA button, checkmark feature lists, grouped feature subheadings, seat stepper input, footnote line, footer bar; imagery register: icons only; backgrounds flat.

required_interactions: Switch Team between monthly and annual billing
acceptance_checks: A 35-person team can verify its Team price without mental arithmetic.
Plan differences, limits, billing cadence, and cancellation terms remain legible.
The recommended choice, if any, states a fit reason and does not use unsupplied popularity evidence.
The build stays within the supplied house style register; the assigned direction expresses itself only within it.
